children: Abhijit Y. Talwalkar, Director, reported purchasing 7,900 iRhythm common shares through The Talwalkar Living Trust dated August 2, 2013, of which he is trustee, at a weighted-average price of $96.6717 per share. The total purchase amount was $763,706. After the transaction, Talwalkar directly owned 21,872 shares and indirectly owned 7,900 shares through the trust.
